_note: Waterfalls drawn on the map. line is the creek's course through the falls, upstream first (from OpenStreetMap); the cascade itself is an illustration. Facts come from the source named.

falls.blurb: A waterfall on Wallenpaupack Creek in Hawley, about a mile below the dam. It drops through a rock gorge beside an 1890 glass factory that is now Ledges Hotel, whose wine bar has open-air decks overlooking the falls.
